body:
## Code Review

This pull request transitions the paper workspace from a single hardcoded topic route to dynamic, parameter-based topic routing (`/workspace/9709/p3/topics/:topicId`). It introduces dynamic topic profiles, updates the student adapter to load topic-specific data, and enhances the Copilot evidence wording gate to handle visual display and rights-blocking postures. The review feedback highlights two important edge cases in `v1-student-adapter.js` where missing topic information on artifacts or tasks can incorrectly fall back to the default 'integration-techniques' topic, and provides suggestions to guard these checks.
